capa.intro: Contain the problem now, remove the cause, then check that it worked.

kindHelp.containment: Limits the harm right now (ISO 10.2 a). Checking the effect is optional.
kindHelp.corrective: Removes the cause so it does not happen again (ISO 10.2 b–c).
kindHelp.preventive: Stops a similar problem elsewhere. If it is a risk, create a risk with "Create from this".

why.title: Why did it happen?
why.hint: Find the cause so it does not happen again (root cause). Ask "why?" until you reach something you can change.

what.title: What are we doing about it?
what.hint: Stop the damage now, then remove the cause. Give each action an owner and a date.

effect.title: Did it work?
effect.hint: Some time after an action is done, check that the problem has not come back (effectiveness check). Record the answer on the action above.
effect.summary: {{ worked }} of {{ total }} actions have worked
